description_en: Resets the password of an application account
kebab_example: aliyun polardb reset-application-account-password --application-id pa-bp1abcdef1234567 --account-name mcp_user --new-account-password Pw123456 --api-version 2017-08-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetApplicationAccountPassword

parameters.help_en: The application ID. Only applications associated with PolarDB for MySQL clusters are accepted. Before the call, you can obtain the DBClusterId associated with the application by calling DescribeApplicationAttribute, and then query the DBType of the cluster by calling DescribeDBClusterAttribute to confirm that the value is MySQL. Associated applications of other engine types are not applicable
parameters.help_zh: 应用 ID。仅接受关联 PolarDB MySQL 版集群的应用。调用前可通过 DescribeApplicationAttribute 获取应用关联的 DBClusterId，再通过 DescribeDBClusterAttribute 查询该集群的 DBType，确认取值为 MySQL。其他引擎类型的关联应用不适用
parameters.name: application_id
